subject: Startups
title: Net Promoter Score
description: A quick win: understand Net Promoter Score.

hook.text: Would your customers recommend you? NPS asks that question on a 0–10 scale and reveals your word-of-mouth power.

buildup.text: Scores 9–10 are promoters. 7–8 are passives. 0–6 are detractors. NPS = % promoters minus % detractors.

discovery.text: Apple's NPS is around 72. Comcast is often negative.

twist.text: NPS can mislead. A score of 50 might mean 60% promoters and 10% detractors—or 50% promoters and 0% detractors.

climax.text: NPS is a leading indicator: high NPS predicts organic growth. Low NPS predicts expensive marketing bills.

punchline.text: Happy customers do your marketing for free.

quiz.question: How is NPS calculated?
options: Percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors
